datasets.name: vertebrae localization and identification dataset from Spineweb

methods.name: UNet
methods.description: Baseline method using a publicly available implementation in PyTorch.

methods.name: cGANMAR
methods.description: Model trained with the official code of Pix2Pix, identical to Pix2Pix at the backend.

methods.name: Pix2Pix
methods.description: Backend implementation used for training cGANMAR.

methods.name: CNNMAR
methods.description: Supervised approach to metal artifact reduction (MAR) used to synthesize metal artifacts by simulating the beam hardening effect and Poisson noise during synthesis of polychromatic projection data.

methods.name: LI
methods.description: Conventional method widely used for metal artifact reduction (MAR)

methods.name: NMAR
methods.description: Conventional method widely used for metal artifact reduction (MAR)

methods.name: CycleGAN
methods.description: Unsupervised state-of-the-art approach to image-to-image translation problems

methods.description: Unsupervised state-of-the-art approach to image-to-image translation problems

methods.name: DRIT
methods.description: Unsupervised state-of-the-art approach to image-to-image translation problems

methods.name: artifact pyramid decoding (APD)
methods.description: A design that merges artifact code and content code at different scales across a feature pyramid during decoding of an artifact-affected image

methods.name: upsampling
methods.description: Interpolation followed by a convolutional layer to avoid the checkerboard effect

methods.name: ADN
methods.description: A framework that learns encoders and decoders to achieve artifact disentanglement without requiring paired data, optimized via an objective function combining adversarial losses, an artifact consistency loss, a reconstruction loss, and a self-reduction loss.

methods.name: artifact consistency loss
methods.description: Addresses anatomical preciseness defined as Lart=EI,Ia[||(xa−ˆx)−(ˆya−y)||1], requiring xa and ˆx to be anatomically close based on the observation that the difference between xa and ˆx and the difference between ˆya and y should be close due to using the same artifact.

methods.name: Self-Reduction Loss
methods.description: Regularizes artifact reduction with regression Lself=EI,Ia[||˜y−y||1] by first adding artifacts to y to create ˆya and then removing artifacts from ˆya to produce ˜y.
